question_en: List the agreements under Agenda Item 7.1 (NR MIMO) at meeting RAN1#115 (MIMO meeting outcomes).
cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#115'}) WHERE ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1' RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, a.sequence LIMIT 15
